description.p: Soplos Plymouth Manager chooses, previews, installs and removes the Plymouth boot splash themes of Soplos Linux. It works on Xfce, Plasma and GNOME, with X11 or Wayland, and rebuilds the initramfs with dracut or with initramfs-tools, whichever the system uses. Every change to the system goes through a Polkit-authenticated helper and the window never runs as root.

El Gestor Plymouth Soplos elige, previsualiza, instala y quita los temas de arranque Plymouth de Soplos Linux. Funciona en Xfce, Plasma y GNOME, con X11 o Wayland, y reconstruye el initramfs con dracut o con initramfs-tools, el que use el sistema. Cada cambio en el sistema pasa por un ayudante autenticado con Polkit y la ventana nunca se ejecuta como root.

Le Gestionnaire Plymouth Soplos choisit, prévisualise, installe et supprime les thèmes de démarrage Plymouth de Soplos Linux. Il fonctionne sur Xfce, Plasma et GNOME, avec X11 ou Wayland, et reconstruit l'initramfs avec dracut ou initramfs-tools, selon le système. Chaque modification du système passe par un assistant authentifié par Polkit et la fenêtre ne s'exécute jamais en root.

Der Soplos Plymouth-Manager wählt die Plymouth-Themes des Startbildschirms von Soplos Linux aus, zeigt sie in der Vorschau, installiert und entfernt sie. Er läuft unter Xfce, Plasma und GNOME, mit X11 oder Wayland, und erzeugt das Initramfs mit dracut oder initramfs-tools neu, je nachdem, was das System verwendet. Jede Änderung am System läuft über einen per Polkit authentifizierten Helfer, und das Fenster läuft nie als root.

O Gestor Plymouth Soplos escolhe, pré-visualiza, instala e remove os temas de arranque Plymouth do Soplos Linux. Funciona no Xfce, Plasma e GNOME, com X11 ou Wayland, e reconstrói o initramfs com o dracut ou com o initramfs-tools, consoante o que o sistema usa. Cada alteração ao sistema passa por um auxiliar autenticado com o Polkit e a janela nunca corre como root.

Il Gestore Plymouth Soplos sceglie, visualizza in anteprima, installa e rimuove i temi di avvio Plymouth di Soplos Linux. Funziona su Xfce, Plasma e GNOME, con X11 o Wayland, e ricostruisce l'initramfs con dracut o con initramfs-tools, a seconda di ciò che usa il sistema. Ogni modifica al sistema passa da un helper autenticato con Polkit e la finestra non gira mai come root.

Managerul Plymouth Soplos alege, previzualizează, instalează și elimină temele de pornire Plymouth ale Soplos Linux. Funcționează pe Xfce, Plasma și GNOME, cu X11 sau Wayland, și reconstruiește initramfs cu dracut sau cu initramfs-tools, după cum folosește sistemul. Fiecare modificare a sistemului trece printr-un ajutor autentificat cu Polkit, iar fereastra nu rulează niciodată ca root.

Менеджер Plymouth Soplos выбирает, показывает в предпросмотре, устанавливает и удаляет темы загрузочного экрана Plymouth в Soplos Linux. Он работает в Xfce, Plasma и GNOME с X11 или Wayland и пересобирает initramfs с помощью dracut или initramfs-tools, в зависимости от системы. Каждое изменение системы проходит через помощник с аутентификацией Polkit, а окно никогда не работает от root.

description.p: Applying a theme rebuilds the initramfs of every kernel with update-initramfs, which also copies it to the EFI partition when the system boots with systemd-boot, so the new theme is seen with the three boot loaders of Soplos Linux Installer.
The screenshots are installed with the package, the application metadata points to the installed launcher, and the manual page is the same in the project and in the package.
The window no longer has the frame of the system: it is a card with rounded corners and its own minimize, maximize and close buttons.
New application icon, new hero image and new screenshots, taken with the interface in English.
First beta of the rewrite of Soplos Plymouth Manager, after the alpha was tested on real hardware.

First alpha of the rewrite of Soplos Plymouth Manager, from Python 3 and GTK3 to Tauri 2 with a Rust backend and a Svelte frontend. It applies, previews, installs and removes themes for real, with dracut or initramfs-tools, on X11 and Wayland. It has not yet been tested on real hardware.
